name: mcp-logger
description: Log meals and discuss nutrition, energy, measurements, sleep, recovery and workouts in your private FitnessTrackr account.

interface.longDescription: Log meals and drinks, search UK and branded foods, review nutrition and body measurements, and manage personal macro targets and opt-in reminders. Connect your FitnessTrackr account securely using OAuth. Food and wearable energy values are estimates. Free personal project hosted in the UK. Discuss synced sleep schedules, recovery/vitals and workouts privately through ChatGPT, with source and freshness information.
defaultPrompt: Estimate this meal and ask before logging it.
Show my nutrition and waist trends.
